title: Evidence, Audit, Observability, and Cost Ledger
summary: P139 starts enterprise evidence, audit, observability, and cost ledger readiness with a contract-only safety boundary.
detail: P139.1 defines the future enterprise ledger contract without enabling DB/runtime writes, provider/model calls, tool execution, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or spend.

subphases.title: Contract / Policy / Safety Boundary
subphases.narrowGoal: Define the enterprise evidence, audit, observability, and cost ledger contract and safety boundary without adding live ledger writes.
subphases.dataShape: Contract-only future ledger shape. No runtime module, persistence adapter, DB/runtime write, provider call, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network call, or spend is enabled.
subphases.commandCenterUx: Preserve existing Command Center pages. OS Roadmap may show P139.1 as complete/current and P139.2 as next. No primary UX may expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw ledger payloads, project/private raw IDs, or fake runnable actions.
themeRequirements: Validate through existing route-wide Command Center Playwright coverage.
safetyRules: Do not write ledger records in P139.1.
Do not write DB/runtime state in P139.1.
Do not call providers or models in P139.1.

Do not execute tools, start MCP servers, dispatch agents, mutate project files, apply patches, run project builds/tests, execute rollbacks, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P139.1.
Do not expose raw/private identifiers, raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw ledger payloads, or fake working actions in primary UX.
reuseCheck: Reuse shared/reportMetadata.js when report metadata is required.
Reuse shared/resultEnvelope.js for future ledger result envelopes.
Reuse shared/modeGuard.js and shared/redaction.js for future admission and redaction checks.
Reuse existing observability/activity helpers instead of creating duplicate appenders.
Reuse existing cost-center ledger schema/store/recorder helpers instead of duplicating cost logic.
Reuse existing Command Center evidence, audit, activity, observability, and cost cards when UX is allowed in P139.4.
testsAndCheckers: Update enterprise roadmap checker to accept the P139.1 handoff.
Run OS phase status, phase validation coverage, dashboard build, dashboard unit, route-wide Command Center Playwright, and git diff validation.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Update P139 plan, README, platform roadmap, enterprise roadmap, OS phase status, phase index, package script, and generated reports for P139.1 only.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P139.1 complete; P139 in progress; previous P138.7; next P139.2 planned-only.
validationCommands: cd dashboard && npx playwright test tests/routes.spec.js -g "Command Center route-wide UX"
finalSafetyChecks: No projects/**, generated-projects/**, private project roots, dashboard/src/**, dashboard/tests/**, db/**, local-state/runtime/**, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or env changes.

No DB/runtime writes, live CRUD, provider/model calls, tool execution, MCP startup, agent dispatch, project mutation, patch application, project build/test execution, rollback execution, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or spend.
No raw/private IDs, raw JSON/log/policy/ledger dumps, demo leakage, stale labels, fake runnable actions, or unsafe positive claims.
No stale P139.1 pending marker remains after the stamp commit.
